name: To Encounter Creative Insanity
source:
The Creator finds themselves trapped inside their own mind. Sade explains: “This is where we live. All your characters.” But there’s an intruder no one recognizes. 

Together, they must travel deeper, through doors that lead to the very core of the Creator’s subconscious.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=31161]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
